description: Scaffold a new OpenSpec change for co-development

change_name.description: The name of the OpenSpec change folder (e.g. agent-workflow-update)

title.description: High-level title or intent of the change

steps.title: Create proposal.md stub
steps.command:
echo '# Proposal: {{title}}

## Intent

## Success Criteria

## Layer Affected
' > openspec/changes/{{change_name}}/proposal.md

steps.title: Create design.md stub
steps.command:
echo '# Design: {{title}}

## Data Flow

## Zod Schemas
' > openspec/changes/{{change_name}}/design.md

steps.title: Request human review on Proposal
steps.description: Review the newly scaffolded proposal and design for {{change_name}}.
